title: SB027 · The night watch (source scene 21–22)
subtitle: Silent · emotion Quiet · three shots, 8 s each · the uru at sea, late at night · Ranjith, 2026-11-07

panels.title: The sleeping deck
beats: Looking aft: the deckhouse windows glow from the lantern inside; the wheel is seen through them.
0–2 s still: Raghavan, Babu and Sasi asleep on the mats; Aashaan at the wheel inside.
2–6 s Babu turns over; Aashaan eases the wheel; lantern light swings.

panels.title: Aashaan at the wheel inside
beats: Inside the deckhouse, from directly behind and a little above Aashaan, centred on him and the wheel.
0–2 s both hands on the spokes, facing forward; Antony small at the bow straight ahead.
2–6 s a quarter turn right and back, hand over hand, body square behind the wheel.
panels.refs: start image @s21sh02start · @aashaan (from behind) · @antony20 (small, at the bow)

panels.title: Antony keeps watch forward
beats: Looking forward over the bow: stem post, bitts, coiled rope, moon high on the right.
0–2 s Antony at the rail, breathing, swaying with the roll, shifting his weight (never a statue).
2–6 s rubs his neck, leans on the rail, scans the water left to right.
6–8 s quiet beat, still alive: straightens, hand on the rail, head turning back to the horizon. Leads into SB028.

panels.title: 3D blocking: who stands where
beats: Deckhouse roof removed and walls cut down. Red Aashaan at the wheel inside; orange sleepers on the deck; green Antony at the bow; blue pyramids are the three cameras.
